name: create_alert
description: Create a proactive alert in Jarvis. Use when the user wants a notification or warning to be created, especially for system issues, weather risks, workflow-generated warnings, or anything that should appear in alerts and optionally speak immediately. This uses the same backend alert manager as the FastAPI webhook endpoint. Required: title, source. Optional: description, severity, metadata, auto_resolve_url. If metadata includes dedupe_key, pending alerts from the same source with that exact dedupe key are suppressed as duplicates. High and critical alerts can speak immediately.

source.description: Source system name, such as 'crop_frost_watch', 'workflow', 'uptime_kuma', or 'custom'

severity.description: Alert severity. Default: high so alert-producing workflows speak immediately unless they explicitly choose low or medium.

auto_resolve_url.description: Optional URL to check for automatic resolution

metadata.description: Optional metadata object stored with the alert. Include metadata.dedupe_key when you want duplicate suppression for the same source and condition.

related_intel_file.description: Optional intel file path related to this alert

speak_immediately.description: Whether to speak the alert right away for high/critical alerts. Default: true
